description: The reclaim rows of ImpAI's handicap exemption (rows 11 and 12, the reclaim payout 0x4238C4 energy and 0x423918 metal; row 17, the reclaimed unit's credit 0x486CDA), applied by tools/impai/handicap_check.py to impai-handicap.json: for each computer seat -- seat 1 OTA AI, seat 2 ImpAI -- one CORE construction kbot beside a Dragon's Teeth feature (8 metal, so its reclaim pays 20 ticks after it starts: the countdown 15 + (energy + metal) / 2, two a working call, engine/orders.md) and another beside a Dragon's Teeth unit of its own seat, each ordered to reclaim it. Both payout compares run whatever the feature's values (0x4238B3..0x423918, DISASSEMBLED). The box round (7024, 1700) is dry, flat and holds no map feature (heights 80 to 85 against the sea's 75, read from the map's attribute grid), far from the three seats' starts. The stock AI's builder planner reorders seat 1's kbots every 90 ticks; handicap_check.py re-issues each reclaim every 45 ticks until its row has counted the seat.
